subject: CS Handoff: model shortlist + context inventory for NovaCare onboarding
messages:
From: Luis Gomez <luis.gomez@novacare.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: amanda.kemp@novacare.com, contracts@novacare.com
Date: 2027-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Discovery notes + token counts for triage

Thanks Soojin — this is great context. Quick answers to your discovery ask:

- Peak concurrent sessions: ~150 (spikes to ~250 for 10–15 minutes during morning sync)
- Average prompt length: 120 tokens; average response target: 160 tokens
- Long-form context: patient history up to ~2,000 tokens for detailed summarization flows
- Expected 1st month volume: ~12M user tokens, ramping to ~60M/month by month 6 (post-beta)

I attached a small CSV with our week-of spikes and a short sample of production prompts.

Two asks on our side: 1) a recommended shortlist of model variants (latency vs quality tiers) you’d like us to prioritize for the POC; 2) any constraints the Redwood Dedicated option has around KV cache size per inference pod (we care about LRU eviction behavior).

—Luis
Luis Gomez
Head of Integrations, NovaCare

Attachments: novacare_token_profile.csv (CSV, 24 KB), sample_prompts.txt (TXT, 18 KB)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Gomez <luis.gomez@novacare.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery notes + token counts for triage

Thanks Luis — this is exactly the level of detail we need. High-level, see the model shortlist I'm proposing below (attaching a PDF with profiles):

- Model A (redwood-opt-1.3b-q4): latency-first, strong instruction-following for short Q&A (target p95 latency < 120 ms for 2k context when batched)
- Model B (redwood-std-7b): balanced cost / quality for summarization and multi-turn flows (good for 2k context)
- Model C (redwood-adv-13b-qa): quality-first for long-form summarization and clinical extraction (prefers 4k+ context)

Notes / immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm % of calls that require the full 2k patient history versus short prompts (we'll use this for cache allocation).
2) Share any PII retention policies (we will surface to security/compliance).
3) Can we do a short call (30m) to validate the ramp plan and canary windows? I’m proposing Wed 10/13 11:00am PT — link: https://cal.example.com/meetings/soojin-novacare-10-13

Ben & Grace — please review the shortlist and confirm resource estimates for the Dedicated pool (GPU types, KV cache sizing) and a rough cost delta between Model A -> C for their projected ramp (12M -> 60M tokens/month).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: novacare_model_shortlist_v1.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-11T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CS Handoff: model shortlist + context inventory for NovaCare onboarding

Looping in a rough capacity sketch based on the numbers:

- Assumptions: 60M tokens/month steady state, average context+response = 280 tokens per request, concurrency target 250 p95 spike.
- Suggested Dedicated pool: 6x H100-equivalent inference nodes (24GB-48GB partitions depending on quantization), autoscale buffer for +40% burst.
- KV cache: allocate 12GB/pod (LRU, shard-local). That supports ~2k contexts cached for ~150k active users depending on prompt size.
- Cost delta: Model A (opt-1.3b-q4) baseline; Model B ~2.6x cost per token; Model C ~4.8x cost per token (numbers approximate, include batching gains).

Operational asks:
- Grace: prepare a short runbook for how we’ll evaluate QA quality on Model B vs Model C (precision on entity extraction, hallucination rate).
- Marissa: queue the customer for a 2-week POC slot in the Oct-Nov calendar window; block 10/25–11/8 for initial evaluation if Novacare confirms.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Product Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: mutual_action_plan_NC.docx (DOCX, 36 KB)

From: amanda.kemp@novacare.com <amanda.kemp@novacare.com>

Date: 2027-10-12T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CS Handoff: model shortlist + context inventory for NovaCare onboarding

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from Product:
- Full-history (~2k tokens) is required for ~18% of our flows (clinical summaries). The rest are short interactions.
- We need guardrails around hallucination for extraction tasks; our triage requires recall > 92% for key clinical fields.
- Legal: can you include a short statement on data residency and audit log retention for the POC? Our contracts team needs that to move the SOW forward.

We confirmed Wed 10/13 11:00am PT works — will send calendar invite.

Thanks,
Amanda Kemp
Senior PM, NovaCare

Attachment: none

Subject: Re: CS Handoff: model shortlist + context inventory for NovaCare onboarding — next steps

Recap and action items from thread / prep for tomorrow's call (10/13 11:00am PT):

1) Model shortlist attached (A / B / C). For the POC we propose running Model B and Model C in parallel with traffic-split canaries (50/50) for quality evaluation.
2) Ben will provision a 6-node Dedicated pool with 12GB KV cache per pod and +40% autoscale buffer. Estimated baseline spend for month 1 POC: ~USD 18k–25k depending on observed batching.
3) Grace will bring an evaluation checklist focused on: entity extraction precision/recall, hallucination examples, latency p95, token utilization by prompt type.
4) Contracts/legal: Redwood will provide a one-paragraph data residency and audit-log retention note in the SOW draft before EOD 10/14.
5) NovaCare to confirm sample prompt sets and approve the mutual action plan document.

Attachments for the call: novacare_model_shortlist_v1.pdf, novacare_token_profile.csv, MUP-qa-prompts.txt, mutual_action_plan_NC.docx

See you all tomorrow — agenda: 10m intros; 20m model recs & capacity; 20m canary plan & evaluation metrics; 10m next steps / SOW timeline.

Best,
